facts.fact: The Federal Government's National Emergency Relief and Stabilisation Intervention pays selected beneficiaries N50,000 into a mobile wallet, with disbursement announced as started by the humanitarian affairs minister on 30 October 2026 and payments continuing in phases.
facts.system: National Emergency Relief and Stabilisation Intervention (NERSI)

facts.fact: The ministry's NERSI website says beneficiaries are selected from verified national identity records and the National Social Register, enrolment in both is a prerequisite, and the NIN is linked to the mobile wallet that receives the payment.

facts.fact: The National Social Register, coordinated by the National Social Safety-Nets Coordinating Office, is a digital database of poor and vulnerable households holding data on more than 70 million individuals, per NASSCO.
The ministry says relief beneficiaries are selected from verified national identity records and the National Social Register, with enrolment in both NIMC and the register required.
